caption:
it moved my goal nine days and told me exactly why. no app has ever been that honest with me

#fitnessapp #soma #fitness

slides.text:
I missed two sessions
and slept badly for three nights

It moved my goal
by nine days

And said which days did it

No guilt trip

"Recovery is low today —
take the day off"

So I walked instead

And the week stopped
being a write-off

A plan you can miss

is the only kind
that survives a real life

slides.heading: It tells you the truth about the date
slides.body: SOMA moves the timeline when life does, names what moved it, and rebuilds the week from where you actually are
